name: Sunway Construction Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Sunway Construction Group Berhad 对两家间接全资子公司 Sunway Machineries Services Sdn Bhd 和 Sunway Visioneering Sdn Bhd 启动成员自愿清盘，这两家公司已停止业务并处于休眠状态。此外，公司宣布了多项股息派发，包括2026财年的第一、第二和第三次中期股息以及特别股息。其他公告主要为公司治理和上市相关事项，未披露新的业务扩张或合约。
overview_en: In 2026, Sunway Construction Group Berhad commenced member's voluntary winding up of two indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries, Sunway Machineries Services Sdn Bhd and Sunway Visioneering Sdn Bhd, which had ceased business operations and were dormant. The company also declared several dividends, including first, second and third interim dividends and a special dividend for FY2026.

segments.name: 建筑
segments.note: 2026年，该板块的一家间接全资子公司 Sunway Machineries Services Sdn Bhd 启动成员自愿清盘，该公司已停止业务并处于休眠状态。
segments.note_en: In 2026, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, Sunway Machineries Services Sdn Bhd, commenced member's voluntary winding up; it had ceased business operations and was dormant.

segments.note_en: In 2026, at the group level, several dividends were declared, and an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, Sunway Visioneering Sdn Bhd, commenced member's voluntary winding up.
